# Ice Cream Van Dash

> Ice Cream Van Dash is a free browser-based pixel-art time-management game about serving customers from an electric British ice cream van.

## Play

- https://ice-cream-van-game.vercel.app/

## Game overview

- Match each customer's order before their patience runs out.
- Serve ice creams, lollies, hot chocolate, slush drinks and cold cans.
- Incorrect items deduct their price from the player's takings.
- Upgrade the van's equipment and unlock new pitches.
- Submit completed runs to the worldwide leaderboard.
- Play with touch, mouse or keyboard controls.

## Locations

Christmas Market is the featured starting pitch. Other unlockable locations include Seaside, Village Fete, Football Match, London, Evening Market and Sydney Opera House.

## Public resources

- Sitemap: https://ice-cream-van-game.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://ice-cream-van-game.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Data

Leaderboard entries contain a player-supplied display name and game result statistics. No account is required to play.
